pages.title: Minecraft Zombie Cats Printable Coloring Page
pages.description: Two wet cats stand in rain puddles wearing tattered t-shirts alongside blocky pixelated Zombie mob figures. Crisp vector lines make this printable coloring page easy to fill with colored pencils or alcohol markers.
